_readme: Controls which Relay Research reports appear and where. visibility: "public" = on the website (Intelligence > Latest reports, its own SEO page, sitemap, RSS) and in the dashboard; "private" = signed-in dashboard only; "hidden" = nowhere. Order here is display order. kind sets the category icon/colour (all, collections, payouts, fx, cards, kyc, bank). cardTitle / cardSummary are the short versions shown in lists; the report keeps its full title on its own page. Report content lives in data/<report>.ts.
